bla_glutamatergic_principal_neuron.note: No CL term found for basolateral amygdala glutamatergic principal/pyramidal-like neuron. Searches: 'basolateral amygdala glutamatergic principal neuron'; 'amygdala pyramidal neuron glutamatergic'. CL lacks amygdala-specific excitatory neuron terms.

bla_pv_basket_cell.label: basket cell
bla_pv_basket_cell.note: CL:0000118 'basket cell' is the closest match — a generic GABAergic perisomatic-targeting interneuron. No amygdala- or PV-specific basket cell term exists in CL. Searches: 'basket cell parvalbumin'; 'basket cell'.

bla_pv_axo_axonic_cell.label: pvalb chandelier GABAergic interneuron
bla_pv_axo_axonic_cell.note: CL:4023036 is defined for the pallium/neocortex but describes a PVALB+ AIS-targeting fast-spiking interneuron, matching the BLA axo-axonic (chandelier) cell functionally and by marker. Anatomical scope differs (neocortex vs. amygdala). Searches: 'chandelier cell axo-axonic'; 'chandelier cell'.

bla_cck_cb1_basket_cell.label: basket cell
bla_cck_cb1_basket_cell.note: CL:0000118 'basket cell' is the broadest applicable term. CL:4023071 'L5/6 cck GABAergic interneuron (Mmus)' is CCK-expressing but is neocortex layer-specific and not a perisomatic basket cell equivalent. No amygdala CCK/CB1 basket cell term in CL. Searches: 'cholecystokinin basket cell'; 'CCK interneuron GABAergic'.

bla_som_dendrite_targeting_interneuron.note: No CL term found for somatostatin dendrite-targeting interneuron (amygdala or generic). Searches: 'somatostatin interneuron dendrite targeting'; 'somatostatin neuron GABAergic interneuron'. CL lacks a generic SST dendrite-targeting interneuron class.

bla_calbindin_dendrite_targeting_interne.note: No CL term found for calbindin-positive dendrite-targeting interneuron. Searches: 'calbindin interneuron dendrite targeting'; 'calbindin GABAergic interneuron'. CL lacks a calbindin interneuron class.

bla_npy_neurogliaform_cell.label: neurogliaform cell
bla_npy_neurogliaform_cell.note: CL:0000693 'neurogliaform cell' matches the morphological class (small soma, dense axonal arborization, GABAergic interneuron). No NPY-specific or amygdala-specific neurogliaform term exists in CL. Searches: 'neurogliaform cell NPY'; 'neurogliaform cell'.

bla_vip_cr_interneuron_selective_interne.note: No CL term found for VIP/calretinin interneuron-selective interneuron in BLA. CL:4023016 'VIP GABAergic interneuron' was identified as an ancestor in search results but not returned as a direct hit; it is neocortex-defined and lacks the interneuron-selective targeting specificity. Searches: 'VIP calretinin interneuron selective interneuron'; 'interneuron selective interneuron VIP'.

bla_gabaergic_projection_neuron.note: No CL term found for long-range GABAergic projection neuron (SST/nNOS) of BLA. Searches: 'somatostatin nNOS GABAergic projection neuron'; 'long-range projecting GABAergic neuron'. CL lacks amygdala GABAergic projection neuron terms.

cea_pkc_delta_neuron.note: No CL term found for PKC-delta (PRKCD+) neuron of the central amygdala. Searches: 'PKC-delta neuron central amygdala'; 'PKC delta neuron amygdala GABAergic'. CL does not yet contain amygdala subtype-specific terms at this resolution.

cea_som_neuron.note: No CL term found for somatostatin-positive neuron of the central amygdala. Searches: 'central amygdala somatostatin neuron'; 'somatostatin neuron GABAergic interneuron'. CL lacks CeA-specific neuron terms.

cea_crf_neuron.note: No CL term found for CRF/CRH-expressing GABAergic neuron of the central amygdala. Searches: 'corticotropin-releasing factor neuron CRF amygdala'; 'corticotropin releasing hormone neuron GABAergic'.

cea_medium_spiny_neuron.label: medium spiny neuron
cea_medium_spiny_neuron.note: CL:1001474 'medium spiny neuron' matches the morphological class (ovoid soma, spiny secondary dendrites, GABAergic). The CL definition is striatum-focused; the CeA medium spiny neuron is an amygdala homologue of this striatal type. No amygdala-specific MSN term exists in CL. Searches: 'medium spiny neuron amygdala'; 'medium spiny neuron'.

cea_large_aspiny_neuron.note: No CL term found for large aspiny neuron of the central amygdala. Searches: 'amygdala GABAergic neuron' (batch 2 second attempt; no specific hit). CL lacks morphologically-typed CeA neuron classes beyond MSN.

cea_small_aspiny_neuron.note: No CL term found for small aspiny neuron of the central amygdala. Searches covered in 'amygdala GABAergic neuron' and 'medium spiny neuron' batches. CL lacks morphologically-typed CeA neuron classes at this resolution.

intercalated_cell_mass_neuron.note: No CL term found for intercalated cell mass (ITC) neuron. Searches: 'intercalated cell amygdala'; 'intercalated cell mass neuron FOXP2'. CL does not yet contain ITC-specific terms.

mea_glutamatergic_projection_neuron.note: No CL term found for medial amygdala glutamatergic projection neuron. Searches: 'medial amygdala glutamatergic projection neuron'; 'medial amygdala neuron glutamatergic projection'. CL lacks medial amygdala neuron terms.
